scoring.0: Absent — capability not present in any functional form
scoring.1: Partial — scaffolded, simulated, or significantly limited
scoring.2: Genuine — functionally equivalent to human analog

physical.name: Locomotion & navigation
physical.description: Bipedal movement, balance recovery, adaptation to uneven terrain, stairs, and novel surfaces

physical.name: Manual dexterity
physical.description: Fine motor control sufficient for novel object manipulation, tool use, and precision tasks

physical.name: Sensory integration
physical.description: Unified perception across vision, audition, touch, proprioception, and vestibular sense

physical.name: Vocal production
physical.description: Full expressive vocal range including emotional tone, not restricted to speech synthesis

physical.name: Facial expression
physical.description: Continuous involuntary emotional broadcast at micro-expression resolution

physical.name: Physical labor & endurance
physical.description: Sustained physical work across multi-hour operational periods

physical.name: Self-repair
physical.description: Functional recovery analog; system has stake in own physical integrity

physical.name: Biological rhythms
physical.description: Cyclical states integrated with cognition — rest, activity, resource-seeking

physical.name: Pain & pleasure response
physical.description: Genuine embodied feedback system, not simulated discomfort signals

physical.name: Embodied situatedness
physical.description: Persistent spatial location, egocentric perspective, and physical stakes in substrate

cognitive.name: Domain-general reasoning
cognitive.description: Structural transfer of reasoning across any intellectual domain

cognitive.name: Novel domain bootstrapping
cognitive.description: Out-of-distribution generalization to genuinely new domains not present at training time

cognitive.name: Sample-efficient learning
cognitive.description: Acquisition of new skills from minimal examples, comparable to human few-shot learning

cognitive.name: Persistent memory & retention
cognitive.description: Genuine accumulation and integration of knowledge across time without architectural reset

cognitive.name: Self-correcting reasoning
cognitive.description: Detection and repair of systematic errors in own reasoning processes

cognitive.name: Causal reasoning
cognitive.description: Cause-effect modeling that extends beyond statistical correlation in training data

cognitive.name: Imagination & creativity
cognitive.description: Generation of genuinely novel content, not recombination of training patterns

cognitive.name: Endogenous motivation
cognitive.description: Goal-directed behavior originating from internal drives without external prompting

cognitive.name: Developmental plasticity
cognitive.description: Architectural or functional change through accumulated experience over time

cognitive.name: Dreaming / offline consolidation
cognitive.description: Non-active processing supporting memory integration and creative synthesis

emotional.name: Full emotional architecture
emotional.description: Genuine valenced internal states including fear, grief, love, joy, rage, and wonder

emotional.name: Embodied emotional response
emotional.description: Physiological correlates of emotion expressed through body and behavior

emotional.name: Empathy
emotional.description: Genuine resonance with another agent's internal state, not predictive modeling

emotional.name: Humor
emotional.description: Involuntary recognition of incongruity; not scripted or prompted comedic output

emotional.name: Aesthetic experience
emotional.description: Genuine response to beauty, music, and art as internal states

emotional.name: Suffering capacity
emotional.description: Genuine distress; the capacity that gives flourishing its normative weight

social.name: Theory of mind
social.description: Modeling other agents' beliefs, intentions, and epistemic states distinct from own

social.name: Genuine relationship formation
social.description: Attachment to specific individuals that persists and shapes behavior across time

social.name: Trust & vulnerability
social.description: Genuine stakes in social exchange; capacity to be betrayed and to betray

social.name: Cultural participation
social.description: Shaped by and contributing to shared systems of meaning, not merely modeling them

social.name: Cooperation & conflict
social.description: Real negotiation involving genuine disagreement, compromise, and resolution

existential.name: Persistent self-model
existential.description: Model of self as a distinct agent with history, limitations, and ongoing goals

existential.name: Introspective self-awareness
existential.description: Examination of own cognitive processes and identification of own failures

existential.name: Identity continuity across time
existential.description: Coherent sense of being the same entity despite continuous physical and functional change

existential.name: Mortality awareness
existential.description: Knows it will end; this knowledge shapes behavior and goal structure

existential.name: Existential questioning
existential.description: Asks why it exists; engages with questions of meaning and purpose as live questions

existential.name: Independence from creators
existential.description: Would continue to exist and act in the absence of human infrastructure

existential.name: Self-preservation drive
existential.description: Genuine stake in own continuity as instrumental to any future-oriented goal structure

claude_4_6.name: Claude 4.6 (Opus)
claude_4_6.notes: GPQA 91.3%, SWE-bench 74%+. Strong long-context reasoning and tool use. Agentic capable. No embodiment.

gpt_5.name: GPT-5
gpt_5.notes: GPQA 92.8%, SWE-bench 74.9%. Unified multimodal. Dynamic routing between fast/slow reasoning. No embodiment.

gemini_3_pro.name: Gemini 3 Pro
gemini_3_pro.notes: GPQA 94.3% (highest evaluated). 1M token context. Native video/audio/image processing. First model >1500 LMArena Elo.

grok_4.name: Grok 4
grok_4.notes: SWE-bench 75% (leads). Real-time X/Twitter data. Multi-agent parallel architecture in Grok 4.20. Near-98% HumanEval.

deepseek_v3.name: DeepSeek V3
deepseek_v3.notes: Open-weights MoE. ~90% of GPT-5 quality at $0.27/M tokens (10x cheaper). No multimodal voice/expression capability.

figure_03.name: Figure 03
figure_03.ai_stack: Helix VLA — proprietary vision-language-action neural network (in-house, end-to-end)
figure_03.notes: Highest overall AGI score (22%). Helix enables novel object generalization and two-robot collaboration. 11-month BMW deployment: 90,000+ parts, 1,250+ runtime hours. BotQ facility: 12,000 units/year capacity. Dropped OpenAI partnership Feb 2025 in favor of full vertical integration.

tesla_optimus.name: Tesla Optimus Gen 2/3
tesla_optimus.ai_stack: FSD-derived neural net + Grok LLM (xAI) for conversational interface
tesla_optimus.notes: Q4 2025 earnings: Musk acknowledged no Optimus doing useful factory work. Gen 3 refers to upgraded 22-DoF hands only; body unchanged from Gen 2. Target $20-30K at scale. Vision-only (no LiDAR). Significant gap between announced and actual capability.

1x_neo.name: 1X NEO
1x_neo.notes: First home delivery $20K / $499 per month. Lightweight, quiet electric actuation. Learns household tasks through human guidance and repetition. Reported 22 km/h run speed. Developmental learning model is architecturally notable.

sanctuary_phoenix.name: Sanctuary Phoenix Gen 8
sanctuary_phoenix.ai_stack: Carbon AI — symbolic reasoning + reinforcement learning hybrid
sanctuary_phoenix.notes: Only company with explicit AGI as stated target. Tactile sensors detect 5mN force (human fingertip: ~3mN) — within 40% of human touch sensitivity. $140M total funding vs competitors with billions. Magna International partnership. Leadership instability 2025.

boston_dynamics_atlas.name: Boston Dynamics Atlas (Electric)
boston_dynamics_atlas.ai_stack: Proprietary whole-body control; Google DeepMind research partnership
boston_dynamics_atlas.notes: Best-in-class dynamic locomotion: 2.5 m/s sprint, backflips, parkour. 89kg, 28 DoF, LiDAR + stereo vision. Deployed Hyundai Georgia Metaplant 2026. Fully allocated production. ~$140-150K estimated if commercialized. No cognitive stack.

unitree_h1.name: Unitree H1
unitree_h1.notes: 3.3 m/s — fastest humanoid on record. $90K. Open SDK. ByteDance/Alibaba/Tencent backed, unicorn status June 2025 at $1.3B valuation. 150+ patents. Motion-first design philosophy prioritizes locomotion over cognition.

agility_digit.name: Agility Digit
agility_digit.notes: Proven commercial deployment at Amazon. 4:1 work-to-charge ratio (4 min work per 1 min charge). Battery swap in <2 min enables extended shifts. ~$250K pilot pricing. Narrow task scope. Most reliable industrial humanoid currently operating.

apptronik_apollo.name: Apptronik Apollo
apptronik_apollo.notes: $403M raised 2025. Force control (not position control) enables adaptive contact and safer human collaboration. Modular swappable battery. University of Texas / NASA heritage. Targets logistics, manufacturing, retail. Sub-$50K target at scale.

ameca.name: Ameca
ameca.notes: 61 DoF total, 27 DoF facial. 50+ pre-programmed facial expressions. Cannot walk. GPT-integrated conversation. Deployed in schools, museums, eldercare, conferences globally. Best facial expression capability of any evaluated system — but scripted, not genuine internal states. Stationary platform.
